text.t: A proud top student with a cannon she built herself. She hides how hard she works.
A soldier-trained transfer student who flies with blades and a cable. Layla’s rival, then her teammate.
The heir of a ruling house on Oro. She builds Angela, then runs away with her.
An android built by Ruby. She learns what warmth, pain and friends are.
The Academy’s Chief Combat Instructor and a sniper. She lost her family and her left eye as a child.
The director of the Science Division and the youngest Chief Scientist in Terrinia. Mr. Bunny, a floating robot, is her best friend.
A proud, rich, loyal fighter who never gives up on Vexana.
A quiet fighter who carries a deep guilt. She takes the Enders’ side to protect Guinevere.
A Science Division student who rides a dragon-like machine, Silverbolt. She is an Ender who grew up among humans.
The first Ender to wake. She commands the Storm Citadel.

also.t: Also: Joe, the Combat Division professor. Roger, the thin boy on Joe’s team. Hester, the chief of Guinevere’s security detail. Karina, a rescue worker who raised Selena. Tetra, Angela’s doll and camera.

text.t: The Catastrophe. In the years after it, the Enders are everywhere, and the Shield of Dawnbreak fights them.
The Storm Citadel strikes Terrinia. Obsidia sets a child among the survivors.
Guinevere and Vexana team up and win Best Aspirant Duo. Chang’e teaches the Core lesson.
Fanny arrives at the Academy. Layla loses first place. The Enders break the dome, and Layla and Fanny become a team.
Ruby and Angela arrive from Oro, escape their cell, and join the Academy.

timeline.when: In the weeks before the Crisis

text.t: Vexana is dragged into the void and takes the Enders’ side.

The Singularity Crisis. The Storm Citadel arrives, and the Mother Matrix comes through the Singularity. Guinevere and Vexana are swept into a black hole and return. Obsidia’s field cancels aspirant power. Selena goes up to face Obsidia, and the duel is still going when the story stops.
